channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula nas pesquisas presidenciais: veja levantamentos
item.description: Recent polls measure the 2026 race between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), including first and second round simulations.

item.title: Haddad tenta colar Vorcaro em Tarcísio, mas governador amplia vantagem
item.description: Fernando Haddad attempts to link Daniel Vorcaro to Tarcísio de Freitas' administration to deflect criticism, as the governor widens his lead in polls. The PT strategist aims to expose alleged failures of the Republican administration, but Tarcísio's campaign seems more resilient to backlash.

item.title: Lula prorroga crédito de R$ 30 bi para motoristas de aplicativo e inclui vans escolares
item.description: President Lula signed a bill extending the Move Brasil Taxi and Apps program, releasing R$30 billion in subsidized credit for vehicle purchases by taxi, app, and school transport drivers, including school vans.

item.title: Zema e Sebastião Coelho organizam ato contra Moraes em dia de sessão do STF
item.description: The Partido Novo organized a protest against STF Minister Alexandre de Moraes, with Romeu Zema and Sebastião Coelho present, accusing the judge of abuse of power and violations of freedoms. The event coincides with an extraordinary STF session that will analyze cases linked to messages allegedly exchanged by Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro. The PMDF has strengthened security near the Praça dos Três Poderes.

item.title: Como será sessão do STF que vai julgar mensagens entre Moraes e Vorcaro
item.description: The STF will hold a first-of-its-kind session to judge the message exchange between Minister Moraes and former Banco Master owner Daniel Vorcaro. The session, scheduled for 10am, will follow a procedure with Justice Edson Fachin voting as rapporteur. Questions remain about whether Moraes, Mendonça, Toffoli and the attorney general can participate in the vote.

item.title: Lula perde posição no ranking de popularidade entre presidentes
item.description: President Lula (PT) dropped from 6th to 7th place in the regional popularity ranking by CB Global Data, with his positive image falling from 51.9% to 48.5% between August and September. The survey, conducted with 4,275 Brazilians, shows his standing in a balanced state without a linear recovery, reflecting the tighter scenario seen in recent domestic polls.

item.title: STF tem conspiratas e pedido de reforço de segurança para julgamento de Moraes
item.description: The STF requests increased security following threats and suspected illegal surveillance, deepening internal crisis. Justices live in mistrust and may investigate Moraes over ties with Daniel Vorcaro. The DF government bans political demonstrations near the court.

item.title: Entorno de ministros compara conduta de Mendonça à de golpistas às vésperas da eleição
item.description: Minister André Mendonça ordered an investigation into Minister Alexandre de Moraes shortly before the 2026 elections, drawing criticism from colleagues who compare him to coup plotters. The Supreme Court crisis affects election polls, with Flávio Bolsonaro gaining ground and pressure mounting on candidate Lula.

item.title: Crusoé: Eleitores de Renan são os que mais migram para Flávio, aponta Quaest
item.description: A Quaest survey shows that 50% of Renan Santos' voters would shift to Flávio Bolsonaro in a runoff against Lula, while 18% would support Lula and 26% would not vote for either. Despite repeated criticisms, the data reveals greater vote transfer from Renan's base to the PL senator.

item.title: Crise no STF: 68% defendem aumentar exigências para nomeação de ministros, mostra Quaest
item.description: A Quaest poll shows that 68% of Brazilians support raising requirements for Supreme Court appointments, and 53% favor fixed terms and an ethics code for justices. The internal conflict at the Court, involving justices Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça, aligns with rising public distrust, as 56% say they do not trust the Supreme Court.

item.title: Bia Kicis pede votos e orienta eleitores em almoço de empresa do agro
item.description: Bia Kicis (PL-DF) solicited votes for herself and allied candidates during a lunch hosted by Três Pinheiros Sementes in Formosa (GO), claiming it was a birthday gathering rather than a campaign event. She guided voters on the ballot order and endorsed Michelle Bolsonaro, Celina Leão, Flávio Bolsonaro, and other allies.

item.title: Mineiros vão eleger 133 representantes nas Eleições 2026; veja quais cargos
item.description: Over 16 million eligible voters in Minas Gerais will head to the polls on October 4th to elect the president, governor, two senators, 53 federal deputies, and 77 state deputies. The election will also determine national positions including 27 governors, 54 senators, and 513 federal deputies. Minas Gerais holds one of the largest caucuses in the Chamber of Deputies with 53 seats.

item.title: Em Belém, Flávio diz torcer por afastamento de Moraes do STF
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro stated during an event in Belém that he hopes Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes is suspended, calling the hearing a 'vital day' for Brazilian democracy. He linked Moraes to President Lula, advocated for the minister's impeachment without providing evidence, and urged supporters to campaign vigorously in the streets to win votes.

item.title: Eleição 2026: o que os candidatos à Presidência propõem para a saúde?
item.description: Twelve tickets have been approved to run for the Presidency in 2026, with health and violence among the main proposed agenda items. The electoral campaign began on August 16, and the candidates present positions on public health, the economy, and security. The analysis of proposals was based on campaign programs, statements, and social media posts.

item.title: Cezinha de Madureira vendia promessa de acesso a ministros do STF, diz investigação
item.description: Federal Police raided the office of federal deputy Cezinha de Madureira (PSD-SP), accused of promising access to Supreme Court justices to third parties. The alleged 'sale of influence' involves messages where the lawmaker claims to have handled cases with justices André Mendonça and Kassio Nunes Marques. His defense denied wrongdoing, while the PF stated there is no evidence that the justices accepted any benefits.

item.title: Produtora de Dark Horse pagou assessores de Mario Frias durante gravações
item.description: The production company GO Up Entertainment paid advisors of federal congressman Mario Frias during the filming of the movie Dark Horse, which focuses on Jair Bolsonaro's life. Receipts show advisor Rareska Metsker received R$ 24,800, including payments to her mother's company for video services, plus hotel expenses. Another advisor, Luiz Claudio Faria Velloso, also received transfers, with payments taking place between October and December 2024 during filming in Brazil.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede a Dino fim do sigilo sobre caso “Dark Horse”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's defense team requested Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino to lift the seal on investigations into the film 'Dark Horse', which depicts Jair Bolsonaro. The request follows partial disclosure ordered on Sunday. The case involves funding of the controversial documentary.

item.title: “Operadora de emendas” aparece como elo de Cezinha de Madureira com o STF
item.description: Lawyer Mariângela Fialek, identified as an amendment broker, was linked to congressman Cezinha de Madureira in a scheme involving influence trafficking and money laundering at the STF. Phone records reveal coordination between Fialek, Cezinha, and the lawmaker's wife, with Fialek acting as an intermediary between judicial cases and political influence. The Federal Police are investigating high-value fee contracts and corruption involving public officials.

item.title: Ludhmila Hajjar nega convite de Caiado para o ministério da Saúde
item.description: Renowned physician Ludhmila Hajjar declined an invitation from presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado to join the Ministry of Health, stating it is not among her plans. She emphasized her commitment to the Smart Hospital project and the new model of intelligent medicine in partnership with the New BRICS Development Bank.

item.title: Entidade de advogados defende sessão do STF e diz que decisões colegiadas fortalecem a corte
item.description: The National Federation of the Brazilian Bar Association Institutes (Fenia) supports the extraordinary plenary session of the Supreme Federal Court (STF), emphasizing the importance of collegial review of decisions previously made unilaterally. The entity stresses that collegial decisions strengthen the court's institutional authority. The session is scheduled for Tuesday (15), following the release of the statement.

item.title: Macallan "que Lulinha gosta" entrou em pedido de R$ 18 mil para Réveillon
item.description: Lula's son chose Macallan whisky for New Year's in Brasília, revealed in a recording where Roberta Luchsinger ordered nearly R$18,000 in drinks. The same whisky was served at a London event involving authorities like Moraes and Vorcaro. The choice raises questions about elite connections, without confirming the president's direct involvement.

item.title: Vídeo: Senado Verifica: Como votar nas duas vagas para o Senado e evitar erros
item.description: All Brazilian voters will be able to vote for two candidates for the Federal Senate in 2026, with 54 seats at stake (two per state and two in the Federal District). Journalist Paula Oda explains how the voting process works at the ballot box to avoid errors in the election.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro: “Torço para que Alexandre de Moraes seja afastado”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated at a lunch event in Belém that he hopes Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes is removed in the upcoming trial, viewing it as a positive signal for Brazil.

item.title: Mendonça vê tentativa de intimidação em operação autorizada por Dino
item.description: STF Minister André Mendonça criticized the Federal Police operation against a congressman, framing it as political intimidation amid the court's ongoing crisis. He questioned the legality of the action authorized by fellow minister Sergio Dino.

item.title: Com Eduardo no Itamaraty, presidência de Flávio Bolsonaro fará ‘diplomacia bananinha’
item.description: The text analyzes the possibility of Flávio Bolsonaro appointing his brother Eduardo as chancellor at Itamaraty, criticizing Eduardo's previous actions against Brazilian interests and labeling them as 'microwave diplomacy'. It also mentions STF tensions and the 2026 electoral scenario.

item.title: Não peçam menos do Brasil
item.description: The EU's suspension of Brazilian agricultural imports in September highlights structural gaps in Brazil's economic diplomacy, including delays in banning growth promoters and overreliance on few markets. The agribusiness sector hit a record in 2025 exports, but effective international negotiation is urgently needed.

item.title: STF retoma julgamento de Eduardo Bolsonaro por difamação contra Tabata
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court resumes the trial of Eduardo Bolsonaro for defamation against Tabata Amaral, with four justices already voting for conviction. The case involves criticism made by Bolsonaro in 2021 regarding a menstrual distribution bill, accusing the lawmaker of serving corporate interests. The vote was suspended in April by Justice André Mendonça.

item.title: Lula 4 terá fiscal “mais organizado” e juros mais baixos, diz Durigan
item.description: Finance Minister Durigan stated that a potential fourth term for Lula aims for a more structured fiscal framework, lower interest rates, and review of mandatory spending and tax benefits. He supports reforms to the fiscal framework with transparent criteria for benefits.

item.title: Brasileirão: Flamengo mantém favoritismo e tem 66% de chance de título
item.description: Flamengo maintained the lead in the 2026 Brazilian Championship with 66.2% title chances after a 2-1 victory over Corinthians at Maracanã. Palmeiras, with 32.1%, is the main contender, followed by Athletico-PR, Fluminense, and Bahia. The battle for first place remains tight, with just one point separating the top two teams.

item.title: Crise no STF pode ter ‘impacto decisivo’ nas eleições brasileiras, diz Financial Times
item.description: The Financial Times warns that the ongoing crisis at the Brazilian Supreme Court, driven by the clash between justices André Mendonça and Alexandre de Moraes, could decisively impact the 2026 presidential elections. The turmoil is eroding the court’s credibility and directly affects candidates Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro, the latter mentioned in the Banco Master case.

item.title: Mendonça pretende antecipar voto para evitar blindagem de Moraes
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça intends to advance his vote on injunctions against colleague Alexandre de Moraes to prevent another minister from requesting a rehearing. This move aims to expedite the trial and reduce delays in the Master case proceedings at the STF.

item.title: Durigan sugere novo corte linear nos gastos tributários em próximo mandato de Lula
item.description: Finance Minister Durigan proposed a linear tax spending cut of 5% to 10% in a potential third Lula term, criticizing the lack of transparency in tax benefits and advocating for their annual review. He also suggested abolishing individual income tax filings and emphasized the need for a "strong state and strong market" to attract investments.

item.title: Julgamento uniu André Mendonça e Gilmar Mendes em 2025 para trancar inquérito contra Cláudio Castro
item.description: In 2025, ministers André Mendonça and Gilmar Mendes voted to suspend an inquiry against Cláudio Castro at the STF, which involved a controversial plea bargain and footage of cash delivery. The defense argued procedural irregularities, claiming jurisdictional usurpation of the STJ. The case reignited debates on ministerial conduct within the STF.

item.title: Kassio se reúne com Fachin às vésperas de sessão sobre Moraes
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques met with Edson Fachin ahead of the STF session analyzing the PF report on interactions between Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro, focusing on the legality of investigations and the continuation of the probe.

item.title: Pesquisa Quaest: colunistas do GLOBO analisam os resultados da corrida presidencial após a crise Master
item.description: A new Quaest poll commissioned by Grupo Globo examines how the ongoing crisis at the Supreme Court affects the presidential bids of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Felipe Nunes, identifying government approval ratings as the main hurdle for Lula to regain momentum. GLOBO columnists discuss how both campaigns are likely to escalate anti-corruption attacks, while voters can self-identify with candidates through an interactive quiz provided by the outlet.

item.title: TV Globo entrevista daqui a pouco Fernando Haddad (PT); acompanhe
item.description: TV Globo interviews Fernando Haddad (PT), first gubernatorial candidate for São Paulo, live at 12:15 PM on Monday. Broadcast on SP1 and g1, with full replay on Globoplay. Tarcísio de Freitas will be interviewed next, following a draw among parties.

item.title: A corrupção monopoliza o debate eleitoral (por Naiara Galarraga Gortázar)
item.description: Brazil's 2026 election is dominated by the Master Bank scandal, with allegations involving Flávio Bolsonaro and judge Alexandre de Moraes, shifting focus from key issues like security and economy. Corruption becomes the central theme of the campaign, with numerous politicians and institutions implicated in a web spanning the STF, PF, and political parties. The electoral landscape is marked by legal uncertainties and a deeply polarized race.

item.title: Mendonça está impedido de votar. E Kássio, pai de Kevin? E a sede de sangue
item.description: André Mendonça is barred from voting in the STF session due to conflict-of-interest rules for judges who are involved parties in a case. STF President Edson Fachin took over the rapporteurship of cases related to Alexandre de Moraes, while Kássio (father of Kevin) and other blood-related questions are mentioned metaphorically. The text discusses legal and historical aspects without directly involving the candidates.

item.title: Quaest: Preocupação com corrupção sobe de 14% para 22% em 12 dias
item.description: Concern about corruption rose from 14% to 22% in 12 days, becoming the second most cited problem in Brazil, behind only violence. The Quaest survey, conducted between September 10 and 13, interviewed 2,004 people and has a margin of error of two percentage points.

item.title: Escolhido por Gonet para atuar no Master divide aula com Moraes na USP
item.description: André de Carvalho Ramos, selected by Paulo Gonet as a prosecutor for the Master Case, teaches alongside Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes at USP. They co-teach the postgraduate course 'Digital Law: New Challenges of Democracy, Constitution, Rights and Development', created in May 2026, covering topics such as disinformation and electoral law.

item.title: Supremo dirá se o Brasil tem, ou não, um tribunal de confiança
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court will rule on whether Brazil has a court of cassation, a legal figure that can influence important judicial decisions. The analysis aims to verify the existence or not of a specific judicial structure in the country.

item.title: As contas dos votos dos ministros para o julgamento de Moraes no STF
item.description: The STF trial of Alexandre de Moraes, scheduled for Tuesday (9/15), will analyze the validity of the PF report on messages between Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro. With a 3-3 split among justices, Cármen Lúcia's vote will be decisive, while Fachin and Toffoli may not participate.

item.title: Por dentro da rede de influenciadores que ataca o voto feminino no Brasil
item.description: A network of influencers in Brazil has been questioning women's right to vote, raising concerns in the political sphere. Supreme Court Minister Cármen Lúcia told BBC News Brasil that proposing changes to this right is unconstitutional.

item.title: Pesquisa Quaest mostra avanço de Flávio Bolsonaro em região decisiva para a eleição
item.description: The Quaest poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading in the Southeast with 47% against Lula's 31% in a simulated runoff, remaining at 42% versus 40% nationally within the margin of error.

item.title: Conheça o caminho do voto, desde a seção eleitoral até a divulgação do resultado
item.description: The Brazilian electoral process begins at 7 AM with the issuance of the 'zerésima', confirming all candidates are at zero votes. Voting starts at 8 AM, where voters identify themselves using CPF or voter ID, cast their ballots, and after the 5 PM cutoff, encrypted data is sent to the TSE, where supercomputers perform the count using specialized keys, ensuring accuracy and publishing final results.

item.title: Cezinha de Madureira juntou Mendonça e Vorcaro, andou de moto com Bolsonaro e tirou foto com Lula
item.description: Cezinha de Madureira, an influential politician, met with Mendonça and Vorcaro, rode with Bolsonaro, and took a photo with Lula. André Mendonça, supported by allies, celebrated his appointment to the STF after a favorable vote.

item.title: Quaest: 44% têm mais medo de reeleição de Lula; 42%, da volta da família Bolsonaro
item.description: A Quaest/Globo poll shows 44% of voters fear Lula's reelection more than Bolsonaro's return (42%), within the technical tie. Fear of Lula's reelection is higher among evangelicals (54%), while Bolsonaro's return worries more Catholics (48%) and Northeast voters. The survey was filed with TSE with a two-point margin of error.

item.title: Lula é desaprovado por 50% e aprovado por 43%, diz Quaest
item.description: A Genial/Quaest survey released on September 14, 2026, shows 50% disapproval and 43% approval of President Lula; 32% rate the administration as 'great' or 'good' and 38% as 'bad' or 'terrible'. The poll, with a 2-point margin of error and costing R$314,628, was funded by Grupo Globo and registered with the TSE.

item.title: Lula usa Alvorada em live de campanha; TSE havia proibido Bolsonaro de fazer o mesmo em 2022
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) used the Alvorada Palace for a live broadcast promoting his re-election, amid debates over the use of public spaces during campaigns. Lula's team said the broadcast used only campaign equipment and followed TSE regulations. In 2022, the TSE had barred Jair Bolsonaro (PL) from using the same location for electoral purposes.

item.title: Flávio aparece numericamente à frente no 2° turno contra Lula pela primeira vez desde abril
item.description: A Quaest poll released on September 14 shows, for the first time since April, Flávio Bolsonaro leading simulated second-round votes against President Lula (42% to 40%), within the margin of error. The survey was conducted during the Supreme Court crisis and after the Master case seal was lifted, which investigates Jair Bolsonaro's family. Flávio attempts to link Lula to Justice Minister Moraes, while other simulations keep Lula ahead or tied.
